bifrost: no screen saver module or SDK class. Idle display-off and auto-lock live in springboard/src/shell/mod.rs and springboard/wm/src/input.rs; app preferences in springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs; SDK surface: springboard/sdk/src/screen_saver.rs (ScreenSaverView, SaverRunner, SS helpers), springboard/sdk/src/idle_watch.rs (IdleWatch)
summary: Apple's framework is a plug-in interface: a .saver bundle subclasses ScreenSaverView, which the system animates in its own engine. BifrOSt has the view lifecycle, the SS helpers, the configuration options and the idle clock as pure models in springboard/ui and springboard/core, re-exported through the SDK (springboard/sdk/src/screen_saver.rs and idle_watch.rs). It still has no .saver bundle host, no screen saver engine, and no Settings preview or configuration sheet wired to a module. The shell's idle display-off and auto-lock sit underneath, and apps do not yet receive the shell's last-input time.

features.apple: ScreenSaverView: init(frame:isPreview:), startAnimation(), animateOneFrame(), stopAnimation(), animationTimeInterval, isAnimating, draw(_:)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/screensaver.rs; springboard/ui/src/screensaver_manifest.rs (SaverManifest::parse, view); SDK path springboard/sdk/src/screen_saver.rs (re-exports ScreenSaverView, SaverManifest and SaverRunner, which drives a view from a caller's clock); wired: springboard/src/shell/screensaver.rs (drives bifrost_ui::screensaver::ScreenSaverView start/tick/stop/animate_one_frame); no .saver bundle host; springboard/src/shell/hot_corners.rs (CornerAction::StartScreenSaver)
features.note: A module's text descriptor (name, frame interval, gamma fade, backing store, options) builds the view, and the lifecycle and frame catch-up are tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs. Gap: the code of a .saver bundle is not loaded and no screen saver engine runs app-supplied savers, which needs the shell's saver host and the lab machine. Built 2026-10-19: each shell saver has a descriptor (screensaver::manifest, parsed by SaverManifest) that supplies its frame interval, so the Clock saver draws one frame a second instead of thirty and Colours ten; a Hot Corner set to Start Screen Saver (Settings > Desktop & Dock > Hot Corners) starts the saver after the pointer rests in the corner for 350 ms (hot_corners.rs, tested headless). Midget check: Settings > Desktop & Dock > Hot Corners > Top Right > Start Screen Saver, then rest the pointer in the top right corner of the screen for half a second; the saver starts, and moving the mouse ends it.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/screensaver.rs (ConfigureSheet, ConfigureSheet::restore, preview_rect); springboard/ui/src/screensaver_manifest.rs (options from a descriptor); wired: springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (PageId::ScreenSaver, Preview row) and springboard/src/shell/settings.rs (Pick::ScreenSaverPreview); configuration sheet not wired; springboard/src/shell/screensaver.rs (DESCRIPTORS, load_sheet, save_option); springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (screen_saver_page); springboard/src/shell/settings.rs (Pick::ScreenSaverOption, Toggle::SaverOption)
features.note: Options declared in a descriptor build the sheet with range checks, saved values are restored with ConfigureSheet::restore (a value the sheet refuses is skipped), and preview_rect fits the screen into the thumbnail, all tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs. Gap: no configuration sheet is shown in Settings and the shell does not yet read a module's saved values, which needs the Settings page and the lab machine. Built 2026-10-19: the configuration sheet is now shown in Settings > Screen Saver. The chosen saver's descriptor options appear under the Preview row (Clock: Show Date switch, Move Every 30 seconds / 1 minute / 5 minutes, Clock Size Small / Medium / Large; Colours: Colour Change Slow / Normal / Fast; Black has none), a switch or a list of checks per option, and each change is saved at once under ScreenSaver.<module>.<key> in settings.ini and read back by the shell (ConfigureSheet::set_from_text, text_of, choices, bool_or). Picking another saver shows its own options. Still missing: no .saver bundle supplies options, and integer options have no Settings control yet. Midget check: Settings > Screen Saver, tap Clock, switch Show Date off, pick Clock Size > Large, tap Preview; the saver shows only the large time with no date. Pick Colours, then Colour Change > Fast, Preview, and the colours turn quickly.

features.feature: Preference storage for a screen saver module
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. a general defaults store exists; no per-module screen saver domain

features.feature: Window backing store and gamma fade for the saver window
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/gamma_fade.rs (GammaFade, FadeCycle); springboard/ui/src/screensaver.rs (backing store and gamma fade flags); springboard/ui/src/screensaver_manifest.rs (descriptor keys backing_store and gamma_fade)
features.note: The start and stop fade is a tested timeline (FadeCycle fades in after start, out after stop, and stays at full brightness when disabled), and the descriptor sets the backing store and fade flag; tested headless in render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs and ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs, with the earlier ramp tests in render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs. Gap: no saver window type applies the ramp to the display, and the compositor in springboard/wm/ has no gamma fade hook, which needs the display and the lab machine.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/screensaver.rs; springboard/ui/src/saver_random.rs (SaverRandom, a seeded source); SDK path springboard/sdk/src/screen_saver.rs (re-exports ss_random_int_between, ss_random_float_between, ss_random_point_for_size_within_rect, ss_centered_rect_in_rect and SaverRandom); wired: springboard/src/shell/screensaver.rs (ss_random_point_for_size_within_rect places the Clock saver)
features.note: The helpers are tested headless, and SaverRandom is a seeded SplitMix64 source, so one seed replays a saver's motion exactly with no OS entropy (ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs). Gap: the shell's Clock saver does not yet draw its unit values from SaverRandom, which needs the shell wiring and the lab machine. Built 2026-10-19: the Clock saver now draws its position from SaverRandom (clock_spot seeds one source per move, so the same move number always gives the same spot) instead of its own hash; the interval between moves follows the Move Every option. Midget check: Settings > Screen Saver > Clock > Move Every > 30 seconds, Preview, and wait: the clock jumps to a new spot every 30 seconds and never leaves the screen.

features.feature: Idle detection that starts the saver
features.apple: The system starts the saver after user inactivity (screen saver engine)
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/idle_monitor.rs (IdleMonitor, next_check_at); wired: springboard/src/shell/screensaver.rs (IdleMonitor, fed by the shell's last-input time); SDK path springboard/sdk/src/idle_watch.rs (IdleWatch queues BecameIdle and BecameActive and reports next_check_at for an app)
features.note: The monitor reports idle once at the timeout, returns to active on input, and tells a caller when the next check is due, all tested headless in core/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs and sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs. Gap: the shell does not send its last-input time to apps (no control message carries it), which needs a protocol change and a device.

features.apple: Screen saver with password on wake (not a separate Apple API)
features.note: The Low Power shortening and the idle threshold are tested headless against the shell's rule. Gap: the shell does not report its last input time to apps, and no app takes part in the lock.

features.feature: System sleep after the screen is off
features.note: The preference parsing, the never value and the shell's constants are tested headless. Gap: the suspend decision stays in the system layer, and the model cannot change it.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 5 (w5-screen-saver, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. the system reads inhibitors; no SDK call lets an app hold one to block the saver or display sleep

gaps: No screen saver plug-in host: no .saver bundle loading and no engine that calls the view lifecycle (start, animate, stop).
No preview or configuration sheet for screen savers in Settings wired to a module; ConfigureSheet is a model only.
Idle state reaches apps only through IdleWatch with caller-supplied times; the shell does not yet deliver its last-input time to apps.
Display-sleep hold (IDLE_DISPLAY_SLEEP_DISABLED) has no app option; the SDK activity tracker in springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs covers system sleep only.
